generator_cmd: printf %s "$plain" | perl -CS -ne 'print join(" ", map ord, split //), "\n"' | tr -d '\n'  # perl ord: plain decimal char codes
oracle_cmd: printf %s "$encoded" | awk '{m=0; for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i>255||$i!=int($i)) m=1; print (m?"scaled":"plain-bytes")}'  # awk: all integer <= 255 -> decimal codec
